name: Assam Brahmaputra Flood Inundation Assessment
query: Assess flood inundation extent and impacted structures across the Brahmaputra basin in Assam

why_explanation.sensor_choice: Sentinel-1 SAR was chosen due to cloud-penetrating active microwave capability over the monsoon-affected AOI.
why_explanation.confidence_rationale: Confidence is backed by high spatial resolution (10m) and verified water surface backscatter calibration.
why_explanation.methodology: Log-ratio thresholding and deep learning semantic segmentation against baseline pre-event observations.
